ALTER TABLE product_passports ADD COLUMN version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

CREATE TABLE passport_corrections (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, passport_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_passport_correction_version UNIQUE (passport_id, version), FOREIGN KEY(passport_id) REFERENCES product_passports (id), FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id))
CREATE TRIGGER passport_corrections_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON passport_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Passport correction history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER passport_corrections_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON passport_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Passport correction history is immutable'); END
